source_scope: Scientific studies/projects/products; distinguish raw open data from papers and vendor products

records.title: Sensor array optimization for e-nose using different deep learning methods
records.technical_design: classification;gas concentration regression;channel ablation;CNN,GRU,LSTM,SVM
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Article: CNN accuracy 0.986/R2 0.979 with 8 channels, 4 channels accuracy 0.905/R2 0.972; source dataset from previous work, raw not verified

records.title: Sensing prototype detecting ethanol and acetone vapor mixtures
records.technical_design: three sensor time response in flask; compare cross sensitivities to binary mixture and concentration conditions
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Conference Nov2025; IEEE online Mar2026; four concentration conditions; raw and independent headspace ppm not verified

records.title: Multi-gas classification and concentration using compact multitask neural model
records.technical_design: multi-task neural output gas response class & concentration; DS18B20/DHT11 environmental features
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: MQ precise gas generation and ppm calibration to verify; article abstract available

records.title: Indoor harmful gases humidity/background ethanol interference
records.technical_design: dynamic features, SVM 14-to-6 sensor selection; RF concentration trend
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Article: 7 classes accuracy .950 macroF1 .959; regression RMSEP 4.084 R2 .647; real gas specifics and unit raw not verified

records.title: CO–NO2 PWM thermal modulation with MiCS-4514
records.technical_design: 45 PWM heater states, transient fingerprints, PCA/QDA/gradient boost concentration and mixture
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Article reports controlled 100% classes and >0.99 R2; NOT transferrable to MQ7/MQ9 heater profiles without manufacturer and actual hardware verification

records.title: Mixed-gas recognition and concentration with KPCA-KNN-MVRVM
records.technical_design: KPCA nonlinear features -> KNN gas mixture identification; multiresponse sparse relevance vector kernel regression CO and CH4 ppm
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Article: 98.33% recognition, mean relative errors CO 5.58%, CH4 5.38% in original experiments; external validation unknown

records.title: Log main/cross sensitivity mixture inversion SnO2
records.sensor_hardware: SnO2 mixed gas sensors, MQ exact unknown
records.technical_design: logarithmic multiparameter conductance surface; fit least squares; invert mixture gas concentrations
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: H2+CH4,CO+CH4,propane+CH4,ethanol+ammonia,propane+ammonia; reported <=5% in tested mixtures NOT Tank claim; full data not open

records.title: Nonlinear least squares sparse gas mixtures inversion
records.sensor_hardware: multi gas sensor eNose; MQ unknown
records.technical_design: observed pattern y approximated by A x with x nonnegative gas abundance; sparse candidate set, nonlinear least squares
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Linearity only local approximation; sparsity and identifiability require validation; no Tank standards

records.title: Multivariate curve resolution alternating least squares
records.technical_design: MCR-ALS alternates latent component profiles and contribution curves; mixtures and concentration/sensitivity profiles
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Abstract describes initial synthetic dataset; gauge actual physical experimental evidence carefully

records.title: Gas sensor array under dynamic binary mixtures UCI322
records.technical_design: time plus CO/methane setpoint and ethylene ppm, 16 conductance channels, 100Hz 12 hours for each of two runs
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: 4,178,504 TIME ROWS, not independent exposures; two long experiments; academic only license on UCI page requires license review

records.title: Gas sensor array under flow modulation UCI308
records.technical_design: 58 independent trials, 12 classes acetone/ethanol mixtures, fan flow modulation, low/high frequency features, PLS two-output regression
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Already counted in Tank UCI G2 corpus, aqueous v/v solution labels not verified gas-phase ppm; do not double count

records.title: Gas sensor array turbulent gas mixtures UCI309
records.technical_design: 180 distinct 300s trials; two wind tunnel plumes; 60s baseline,180s exposure,60s purge; GC-MS reports MEAN ppm labels
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Already counted in Tank UCI G2; per-second fast ppm NOT measured by GCMS; group whole trials

records.title: Tree-model gas mixture identification Scientific Reports
records.sensor_hardware: 16 TGS MOS from UCI322 not MQ
records.technical_design: 16 features, PCA, DT/RF/ExtraTrees for two binary mixture classes
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: ET 99.15% class recognition in reported folds; same UCI322 input, not independent dataset; not 99.15% separate ppm accuracy

records.title: AI VOC mixture classification by temp modulated array
records.technical_design: square-triangular heater profiles, RF and CatBoost, acetone/isopropanol/toluene mixtures
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: RF 91% mixture class accuracy; CatBoost 84% class on transformed individual VOC examples; not independent per-gas ppm results

records.title: MoS2 NH3+NO2 mixed gas quantitative regression
records.technical_design: binary gas 15 mix conditions PCA, SVR/MLP/RF separate outputs for ammonia and nitrogen dioxide ppm
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Paper R2 NH3 .974, NO2 .994 in controlled source, 15 mixture conditions; cross-platform methodology only

records.title: Au-decorated oxide array CNN mixture classification
records.sensor_hardware: In2O3,SnO2,TiO2 gold nanoparticle sensors not MQ
records.technical_design: specific-sensitivity materials+CNN; NO2+CO and NH3+NO2 binary mixtures
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: High recognition in studied samples is not independent per-component concentration

records.title: Blind deconvolution of slow MOX dynamics
records.technical_design: fit nonlinear 1st-order dynamics in log domain by least squares; use two sensors with different tau to recover shared transient inlet without fast PID
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Reconstructs rapid changes of shared source signal, NOT chemical separation of two gas species

records.title: RSC gas filtration sorption MOFs and molecular sieve overview
records.technical_design: upstream filters adsorb competing VOCs, molecular-sieve pores, catalytic converters, temporal elution; change transmitted fractions
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Finite capacity/breakthrough, humidity, target adsorption and altered sensor transient can create missed alarms; requires quantitative upstream/downstream calibration

records.title: Zeolite modified metal oxide sensors thesis
records.technical_design: zeolite Y/ZSM-5 catalytic filter beds, GC/MS chemistry, 200-400C, sensor selectivity
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Requires external heated catalytic reactor; not safe simple hobby add-on to Tank MQ chamber

records.title: Bosch BME688 AI-Studio ecosystem
records.technical_design: 10-step heater profile, specimens/class training, dataset evaluation, export BSEC firmware config
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Product verification; closed ecosystem, no claim of quantified unknown gas mixture without training data

records.title: Alpha MOS HERACLES NEO GC eNose product
records.sensor_hardware: dual GC columns+dual FIDs not MQ
records.technical_design: physically chromatographically separate before detect; Tenax preconcentrator trap then dual polarity columns and chromatograms; retention library
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Strong chemical selectivity but complex high-energy instrumentation; concept belongs central lab not Tank MQ chamber

records.title: Alpha MOS FOX MOS electronic nose product
records.technical_design: pump flow and temperature-controlled chambers, resistive response fingerprints and multivariate classification
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Detect odor classes/fingerprints not molecular chromatographic separation

records.title: Juice e-nose design three stage physical sampling
records.technical_design: controlled pump 1 sampling; pump 2 clean-air purge; 1.88 L chamber; feature extraction and classification
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Demonstrates why flow/purge timing, memory and chamber conditions must be modeled

records.title: Orthogonal signal correction for drift-resistant vapor regression
records.technical_design: baseline manipulation+orthogonal signal correction, PLS regression essential-oil vapor measurement
records.reported_evidence_and_limits: Separates baseline drift from useful chemical signal; do not remove true changing exposure dynamics

guardrails: Multi-label mixture recognition != independent quantitative unmixing
Software candidate filtering != chemically selective air filtering
Do not apply PWM arbitrary to MQ7/MQ9 manufacturer heater cycles
Source and model metrics not transferable to Tank MQ8 without reference calibration
Commercial GC-based eNose has physical separation, array eNose generally only discriminatory fingerprints
No production integration and G3 stays 0/80
